profile_text.body:
Zoom is a publicly traded communications company, founded in 2011 and headquartered in San Jose, California (ticker: ZM, CIK: 0001585521). Its website describes it as offering a platform of collaboration tools including video meetings, Zoom Chat, VoIP phone, webinars, whiteboard, contact center, and events.

On the AI side, Zoom offers a product called Zoom AI Companion, focused on meeting summarization and automating next steps. The company's site also references a feature called ZoomMate, described as going further to generate assets such as decks and documents. Zoom AI Companion is categorized as a chat and general large language model product, with recording consent noted as a relevant consideration for its meeting summarization functionality.

The held facts indicate Zoom has a notable legal footprint in California, with 161 associated legal exposures recorded in that state.
